title: Weather report graphs (visibility >10 miles) closing MUFON case #16726 report
description: Three stacked hourly weather charts headed "Weather report: Visibility >10 Miles": temperature, dew point and normal high/low (°F/°C), barometric pressure (in Hg/hPa), and wind speed and gust (mph/km/h), plotted from midnight through 11 p.m. Below the charts the page reads "End Report," followed by the next case heading "Case #16726 CAT 2 MUFON Deployment."
